Priya: AM async — quick launch check. What I did: finished v2 routing spec and merged the backend prefix-cache PR. Blockers: flaky alloc e2e on nightly, failing ~1/10 runs. Today: finish canary checklist, tidy up CRs and confirm fallback policy for short degradation windows.

Alex: Thanks — can you drop the failing logs here? I can look at the alloc flake after lunch. @Matt fyi on the routing spec changes.

Priya: pasted failing snippet below:
```
AssertionError: allocation mismatch at step=43
  expected free_memory >= requested (got 312MB, wanted 512MB)
  trace: runtime/kernel_selector.cc:145
```
Noticed it spikes when throughput > 200 qps in the sim harness.

Matt: I'll take the CRs tonight (two small cleanup commits). Expect ~2h of review. Re: lint, there's a couple of style nits in model-serving tests, will bundle fixes.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: canary-2026-03-17-01 (ETA 10m) :rocket:

Sophia: Roadmap note — moving "embed cache sharding" out of this sprint to stabilize Dedicated infra tests. Coordinating with infra to reserve GPU fleet for private tests next week. No blockers from PM side.

Dave: Quick ask — any objections to toggling fallback policy to `model-small` for a ~2h window during smoke to reduce IO pressure? :thinking_face:

Alex: +1 from infra. Should help smooth the alloc spikes while we debug.

Priya: +1 from me, I'll add to the rollout notes and set an automatic revert.

Matt: FYI @eng-runtime — the alloc flakiness correlates with batch size > 64 in the sim; could be kernel selection path.

eng-runtime-bot: Created ticket RT-412: alloc flakiness in sim harness (https://redwood/in/RT-412) — assigned to eng-runtime.

Priya: Please drop any CR pings or QA notes in-thread so owners can pick them up. Need someone to own the QA checklist for the canary — @Sophia?

Sophia: I’ll own QA checklist and coordinate smoke runs. Will post checklist items by EOD.

Priya: Awesome — thanks everyone. Will update the rollout doc and ping again once canary starts :thumbsup:

Alex: ping me if the alloc ticket needs a repro harness change.

Priya: noted. End of AM async. :shipit:
